facts.text: Raffles London is located in the former Old War Office building, known today as The OWO.
facts.excerpt: Raffles London is located in what was the Old War Office building, known today as The OWO.

facts.text: The building was once home to Sir Winston Churchill and Lord Haldane.
facts.excerpt: It was once home to legends such as Sir Winston Churchill and Lord Haldane.

facts.text: Ian Fleming, creator of James Bond, was a regular visitor to the building, and scenes from the 007 movies were filmed there.
facts.excerpt: Ian Fleming, creator of James Bond, was a regular visitor to the building and many scenes from the 007 movies have been filmed on location here.

facts.text: MI5 and MI6 had operations in the building during the 20th century.
facts.excerpt: The OWO is associated with spies and espionage, as MI5 and MI6 had operations here during the 20th century.

facts.text: The hotel is located in the heart of Whitehall.
facts.excerpt: Located in the heart of Whitehall, the building has been meticulously restored and is now home to Raffles London at The OWO.

facts.text: The Edwardian Baroque building was restored by expert craftspeople and transformed into Raffles' first London hotel.
facts.excerpt: Edwardian Baroque building has been cherished and restored by thousands of expert craftspeople and transformed into Raffles' first London hotel.

facts.text: The room design was masterminded by Thierry Despont, who previously worked on the Statue of Liberty.
facts.excerpt: The design was masterminded by Thierry Despont, who previously transformed landmark buildings such as the Statue of Liberty.

facts.text: The Heritage Suites occupy former offices of influential political and military leaders.
facts.excerpt: Heritage Suites are situated in the building’s most storied rooms, formerly offices of influential political and military leaders

facts.text: Heritage Suite stays include personalised butler service, flexible check-in and check-out, and complimentary airport transfers.
facts.excerpt: elevated further by personalised Butler Service, flexible check-in and check-out, complimentary airport transfers

facts.text: The Turret Suite is a two-level suite at the top of a turret, with the bedroom below and the living room above.
facts.excerpt: this unique two-level suite at the top of an iconic turret has a lower floor bedroom and bathroom and an exceptional living room above.

facts.text: The Churchill Suite is where Britain's military leaders made key Second World War decisions.
facts.excerpt: This grand suite, where Britain's military leaders made key WWII decisions, features rich wood panelling, grand fireplaces

facts.text: London perfumer Azzi Glasser developed a fragrance for the hotel, used in its bathroom products.
facts.excerpt: London perfumer Azzi Glasser developed a fragrance for the hotel, embodied in a special collection of bathroom products.

facts.text: The window treatments were designed as a nod to the uniforms of the Horse Guards.
facts.excerpt: the window treatments were designed as a nod to the iconic uniforms of the Horse Guards.

facts.text: The Lifestyle Suite includes wellbeing tools such as yoga equipment, TRX suspension and Normatec recovery boots.
facts.excerpt: An immersive, high-tech wellbeing experience, with tools for movement, recovery and nutrition, including yoga equipment, TRX suspension, Normatec recovery boots

facts.text: The Corner Suites are named after women such as Clementine Churchill and notable female spies.
facts.excerpt: These suites below the majestic turrets are named after iconic women like Clementine Churchill and notable female spies

facts.text: Rooms have a minibar stocked with British-made snacks.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy the minibar full of British-made snacks.

facts.text: Chef Mauro Colagreco has his signature restaurant at the hotel, one of three dining experiences he oversees there.
facts.excerpt: Mauro Colagreco brings his signature restaurant to Raffles London at The OWO, one of three dining experiences he is masterminding here.

facts.text: The Mauro Colagreco menu features more than 70 varieties of vegetable and fruit, all produced in Britain.
facts.excerpt: his menu reveals more than 70 varieties of vegetable and fruit, all produced in Britain.

facts.text: Mauro Colagreco is described as a michelin-starred restaurant.
facts.excerpt: Welcome to Chef Mauro’s signature michelin-starred restaurant

facts.text: Afternoon tea is served in The Drawing Room, with a choice of two experiences.
facts.excerpt: Served in the refined setting of The Drawing Room, guests may choose from two beautifully crafted experiences.

facts.text: The hotel's afternoon tea pays homage to the secret history and characters associated with the Old War Office.
facts.excerpt: afternoon tea pays homage to the secret history and the characters associated with the former Old War Office

facts.text: During the Second World War, candidate spies for the Special Operations Executive were interviewed and briefed in the building's basement.
facts.excerpt: Candidate spies for the Special Operations Executive (SOE) were interviewed and briefed in the basement

facts.text: A Gruffalo afternoon tea is offered for young guests aged 12 and under.
facts.excerpt: Designed for young guests aged 12 and under. Available until early January 2027.

facts.text: Children over the age of 12 are welcome at Mauro Colagreco and are offered the regular menu.
facts.excerpt: Children over the age of 12 are welcome to dine with us and will be offered our regular menu.

facts.text: Mauro Colagreco reservations must be cancelled at least 48 hours in advance to avoid a charge.
facts.excerpt: Cancellations must be made at least 48 hours in advance.

facts.text: The spa combines Guerlain treatments with movement and nutrition expertise from Pillar Wellbeing.
facts.excerpt: the prized treatment expertise of Guerlain Paris meets the movement and nutrition skill of Pillar Wellbeing

facts.text: The spa has a swimming pool, a vitality pool, a sauna and a steam room.
facts.excerpt: Access to swiimming pool, vitality pool, sauna, steam room & experience showers

facts.text: The Tea and Tour experience pairs a historical tour of the building with afternoon tea.
facts.excerpt: explore the captivating history of Raffles London at The OWO in this epic Historical Tour before enjoying Secrets & Spies Afternoon Tea.

facts.text: The hotel describes itself as blending historic architecture and modern luxury.
facts.excerpt: Raffles London stands out with its blend of historic architecture and modern luxury
